text:
priya: Quick sanity check on the audit-export docs PR I'm finishing. Main asks: SOC2-safe phrasing, SDK migration note (exportLogs -> startExport), and a Console anchor link fix. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1538
luke: Paste the snippets you plan to include so we can check for PII and placeholders
priya: REST curl (masked):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit-exports"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"filter":{"start":"2024-04-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2024-04-30T23:59:59Z","types":["access"]},"destination":{"type":"s3","bucket":"<S3_BUCKET>"}}'
```
ben: Good. SDK snippet (JS)?
priya: JS migration snippet:```js
// old: client.audit.exportLogs({from, to})
// new:
const job = await client.audit.startExport({
  filter: {start: '2024-04-01T00:00:00Z', end: '2024-04-30T23:59:59Z'},
  destination: {type: 's3', bucket: '<S3_BUCKET>'}
});
console.log(job.id);
```
luke: Change <S3_BUCKET> -> <YOUR_BUCKET>. Add a one-line RBAC note: only org admins can start exports. Also add UTC note: all timestamps are Z (UTC).
compliance-bot: Policy reminder: public docs must not include real emails, IPs, SSNs, ARNs, or credentials. Use placeholders or internal ids. Also suggest a SOC2-safe callout: "Audit logs record security-relevant events and use internal identifiers; exports do not include raw PII by default unless configured by the customer."
priya: Adding that callout and the RBAC/UTC notes. One more: the Console link currently points to /console/audit#exporting but the actual anchor is /console/audit#exports. I'll update the link and add a redirect note for bookmarks.
docs-bot: Pre-merge check: PR 1538 flagged missing retention pointer. Recommendation: add a one-line link to /docs/compliance/retention and note that retention policy changes are recorded as policy.update events.
priya: Will include that line. Also adding a short disclaimer above examples: "Examples use masked/internal identifiers and are illustrative only."
ben: LGTM after edits. Thanks for keeping examples clean.
priya: Pushed updates: renamed placeholders, added RBAC + UTC notes, SOC2-safe callout, retention pointer, anchor fix, and disclaimer. Marking resolved for now.
docs-bot: PR 1538: link checks and PII scan passed on updated commit.
